COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild anemia with low MCHC, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH). There is also monocytosis, basophilia, and elevated alkaline phosphatase. These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory or infectious process, possibly severe viral infection or early sepsis. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are strongly recommended.
